scope: Graceful stop only the seven current running shared containers. Preserve volumes, images, catalog, PostgreSQL, MinIO and all isolated containers.
precondition: Fresh recheck paused DAGs, no active/queued runs, no running/queued writer tasks, source locks0, no Spark writer or active Trino query, no unknown commit; otherwise STOP
method: SIGTERM and monitor orderly exit; no automatic SIGKILL/force-kill. Stop/report on timeout rather than escalating.
after_stop: If owner approves combined plan, restore only listed existing isolated containers under staged gates; otherwise stop/report after the approved shared-stop portion.
optional_combined_approval: Owner may approve this full controlled stop-and-restore plan together; no further source/framework changes proposed.

isolated_restore.gate_after_storage_before_execution: Read-only isolated PostgreSQL/catalog: verify paused/manual-only DAGs, no active/queued runs/tasks/locks or unknown commits, expected empty baseline; STOP and report on drift before scheduler start.
isolated_restore.gate_before_scheduler: Persisted DAGs must be verified paused with schedule=None/retries0; do not start a scheduler with unverified queued work.
isolated_restore.gate_after_restore: Health, exact9 profile/contracts/Raw pins, actual flags/images/limits/readonly mounts,3 fresh RAM samples with intended stack healthy; no writer before PASS.
isolated_restore.writer_authorization: Previously approved one Bronze -> automatic Silver E2E remains conditional on all fresh gates PASS. Never trigger Silver manually.
isolated_restore.limits_unchanged: Runner3 GiB/driver768 MiB/local[2], web1 GiB/one worker; no resizing, pull/build, initializer, volume or data changes.
